$comment: What a new repository starts with. Read by bin/new-repo.sh, checked against blueprint/files/, workflow-templates/ and sync.json by bin/bootstrap-parity.mjs, so a starter or a template cannot be added and forgotten. `from` is a path in this repository, `to` the path in the new one. `substitute` lists the placeholder words replaced by the repository name; any other {placeholder} is left for a person. Templates are rendered as the template sync renders them (site, flags, default branch). `requires` makes an entry conditional: `kind` (--kind, which is needed unless blueprint/release.json exempts the repository, or the release items report drift) or a declared option. A starter with `perKind` has KIND in its `from`, replaced by the kind. A starter or template that is not bootstrapped is in `excluded` with the reason.
